audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2] writes 'Full Flux' for Spell Flux (packet suspectName, confirmed against the kit). tldr and report[0].t call Neeko 'his'. dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[0].d state no interaction at all.
audit.why: Kit: Tangle-Barbs (E) is 1000 range on 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s and becomes larger, faster and longer-rooting after passing through a champion — that is why you stand behind the wave rather than beside it. Blooming Burst (Q) is 800 range on 9-7s. Shapesplitter (W, 16-12s) sends a directional clone; the kit text describes no invisibility, only the disguise from Inherent Glamour. Pop Blossom is a dash-flagged knockup-plus-stun on 120/105/90s. Mirror-confirmed: Rune Prison roots only through Spell Flux, so the lock order is E then W.
audit.corrected: Spell Flux is the name. Tangle-Barbs roots longer once it has passed through a champion, so never let a teammate or your own body extend it. Her clone can eat a mistargeted root.
